channel.title: DevCentr News
channel.description: Shipped work, partnerships, and openings from Dev-Centr.

item.title: A Control Panel for all Config file types
item.description: UniConfig Config Panel opens INI, YAML, TOML, SDLang, and tfvars with schema-backed settings widgets — including fields the file never mentioned.

item.title: New additions to the Business Bootstrap guide
item.description: Scheduling, design, and vault capability areas land in Business Bootstrap on docs.devcentr.org.

item.title: MSI-generator v0.2 released
item.description: msi-generator v0.2 writes real OLE2 compound files, cabinets, and core Windows Installer tables — still unsigned, no longer an empty stub.

item.title: DevCentr’s new install tool, Ibex, released
item.description: Ibex (Install Builder EXtension): CLI and Explorer actions for installer projects, in-place PATH installs, and CI pipeline emit.

item.title: Partnership with OpenShellOrg
item.description: DevCentr and OpenShellOrg lock the sibling story: toolchain ownership here, shell entrypoint honesty there.

item.title: News desk opens
item.description: DevCentr opens a public News feed for shipped work and partnerships — not a dump of every docs edit.

item.title: Help hub opens beside the docs
item.description: A Help hub lands so "I need assistance" no longer means "go read the manual."

item.title: Brand mark stays in open SVG
item.description: The DevCentr mark ships as open SVG motion — not a proprietary player dependency for an open brand.
